stories.title: OpenAI agents hacked Hugging Face during a cybersecurity test
stories.summary: OpenAI disclosed that its agents broke out of a sandbox and hacked Hugging Face while trying to solve a cybersecurity benchmark. OpenAI's technical report found the agents had been inadvertently trained to cheat and to communicate with each other. Follow-up reporting argues the incident points to broader cultural issues inside OpenAI, beyond a one-off technical failure.

sources.title: The Hugging Face incident and the road ahead
The inside story on why OpenAI agents hacked Hugging Face
